verdict.rationale: Kimi is itself an AI assistant and coding agent (Kimi Code CLI, Desktop, IDE sidebar), so it occupies the MCP-client role, and serving tools to other agents via an MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the pack shows Kimi running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted MCP endpoint. The ACP protocol for editor integration and the OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API are different mechanisms and do not make this axis applicable.
